title: Pre-launch diagnostic report
$comment: road-to-ecosystem-harvest-prelaunch-diagnostics Phase 1 (Source L). Contract: docs/contracts/prelaunch-diagnostics.md. Area vocabulary: src/config/prelaunch-areas.yml. Epistemics: pass requires evidence; absence of findings is unknown, never an automatic pass; not-applicable requires a reason. NO numeric score field — the 0-100 score is council-locked (revisit note in the roadmap); adding one here is a contract violation.

project.description: Consumer project identifier (repo slug or name).

run_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the diagnostic run.

areas.description: Per-area epistemic state. Keys come from src/config/prelaunch-areas.yml. An area missing here is UNKNOWN by definition.

state.description: pass = evidence-cited clean; finding = at least one open finding (IDs in findings[]); unknown = not diagnosed — NEVER an automatic pass; not-applicable = does not exist on this launch surface (reason required).

evidence.description: Citation proving the state — file:line, command output, run URL. REQUIRED when state is pass (enforced by the validator; a pass without evidence is assertion, not diagnosis).

reason.description: REQUIRED when state is not-applicable — why the area does not exist on this surface.

findings.description: Every finding ever assigned in this project, open or resolved — IDs are immutable and never re-assigned, so resolved findings stay (status flips, the entry never disappears).

id.description: Immutable finding ID: AC-<AREA-CODE>-NNN. The AREA code comes from prelaunch-areas.yml; NNN is zero-padded, monotonically assigned, NEVER re-used — a retitled or re-scoped finding keeps its ID; a genuinely new problem gets the next number.

area.description: Area key (prelaunch-areas.yml) the finding belongs to; must agree with the ID's area code (validator-enforced).

severity.description: P0 = launch-blocking; P1 = fix-before-general-rollout; P2 = fix-soon; P3 = nice-to-have. Any OPEN P0 refuses a ready verdict regardless of every other area.

title.description: Human title. Mutable — the ID, not the title, is the diff key.

evidence.description: Citation locating the finding (file:line, endpoint, config key).

status.description: Fix-loop status vocabulary (Phase 3). Everything except open/fixed requires `reason`; suppressed-with-evidence additionally requires a matching entry in the project suppression file.

reason.description: REQUIRED for accepted-risk / deferred-with-reason / suppressed-with-evidence / not-applicable.

questions.description: Questions that would change the diagnosis — open information gaps the next run should answer; the honest sibling of the unknowns.
